title: Approved path coverage
$comment: The paths the change set batches are authoring, handed to the materialisation planner so it can only name manifests the change set actually writes.

resolverOwnedPaths.$comment: Approved paths no batch authors because a resolver produces them. The planner reads these to see which lock files its materialisations are expected to account for.

previousMaterializations.$comment: Resolver instructions reused from a previously generated plan for the still-approved manifests.

carriedManifests.$comment: Existing approved manifest bodies provided to the planner during repair.
